desc: Hot gym, long rounds. We fight every type in every division, so bring your best plan.

fighters.name: Stefan Wakefield
fighters.plan:
# Slugger: walk him down and break the body
6B/6/8 (inside)
if opponent <= tired then 7/7/6 (inside)
if hisstuns > 0 then 7H/8/5
if score + 12 - round < 0 and endurance_percent >= 40 then 8H/8/4
if score > 2*(1 + 12 - round) then 3/3/14
